text.intro:
The Rusty Anchor runs karaoke on Tuesdays. Attendance is loyal; talent is not.
Five singers are involved. Determine each singer's slot, drink and reception.
- **Singer**: Bogdan, Caitriona, Vikram, Mercy and Pernilla.
- **Running order** (listed from earlier to later): slot one, slot two, slot three, slot four and slot five.
- **Drink**: a hard cider in a plastic cup; a double bourbon; a rum and coke; a pitcher of light beer; and tap water.
- **Reception**: one heckler, a singalong, the manager cutting the power, a request for an encore nobody wanted and scattered applause.
Every singer has a different slot, drink and reception, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: The singer who gets the manager cutting the power falls somewhere between slot two and slot four in slot order, matching neither.
The singer who orders a double bourbon sings in slot two.
Mercy and slot four are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
The singer who orders a pitcher of light beer is earlier than the singer who gets the manager cutting the power in slot order.
The singer who orders a rum and coke and the singer who gets one heckler are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
One of the singer who gets a request for an encore nobody wanted and Mercy sits at an odd-numbered slot and the other at an even-numbered slot.
The singer who orders a double bourbon and Vikram are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
Bogdan is exactly one slot earlier than the singer who orders a double bourbon, with no slot in between.
The singer who gets one heckler is earlier than Pernilla in slot order.
The singer who orders tap water and the singer who gets a singalong are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
